title: TransportCreditResult
description: Result of the transport.credit JSON-RPC method: the per-connection credit window the renderer must respect (ADR-8eej3e66 section 7). window is how many ordinary calls may be outstanding; exempt methods take no credit; each reserved method has one credit outside the window. A peer that sends more than this is violating the protocol and is disconnected.

window.description: How many ordinary calls this connection may have outstanding at once. Notifications and the methods named in exempt do not count.

exempt.description: Methods that take no credit and are never counted against the window: cancel, ack, the resolvers, the heartbeat and diagnostics. Server vocabulary, never request text.

reserved.description: Methods with one credit of their own outside the window, so a window full of work waiting on an unlock cannot hold up the answer that releases them.
